messages:
incident-bot: Pager — HIGH rate spike detected for org EquinoxOrg (org_id: eq-7890). 95th qps > configured quota. Alert: RL::Spike. https://redwood.in/alerts/3337776543 :rotating_light:

alex (oncall): joining, looking at the org dashboard now.

maya (sre): seen the spike. tail latency up on gpt-small and a few 5xx traces. any idea if they're on dedicated?

jordan (support): Priya is on a call with them — they say their product started retrying and now they hit lots of errors.

priya (acct-mgr): confirming — customer ran a large batch job that started 10m ago. They're asking for immediate relief, otherwise their downstream jobs fail.

alex (oncall): plan: 1) temp increase per-org QPS 2) disable noisy feature flag (onboarding previews) 3) monitor for 15m and either extend or roll back. Agree?

sam (runtime): we can do a soft bump. Suggest qps 10 -> 40 for 30m and toggle feature. Command ready:

sam (runtime): `adminctl rate adjust --org eq-7890 --qps 40 --duration 30m --reason "spike mitigation"`

alex (oncall): executing now. /admin apply-rate --org=eq-7890 --delta=+30 --ttl=30m
deploy-bot: Rate adjustment accepted. change_id: rchg-20260317-01. New org qps: 40. Expires in 30m.

maya (sre): I'll flip the feature flag to reduce extra calls.

sam (runtime): Feature toggle command: `featurectl toggle --org eq-7890 --flag onboarding-preview --off`

deploy-bot: Feature flag updated: onboarding-preview = OFF for org eq-7890.

alex (oncall): metrics check: prefix cache hit ratio up, average tail latency dropping ~45% in last 2m. Errors down from 8% -> 2.2%.

jordan (support): Priya reports customer seeing fewer 5xx's and retries backing off. They're running verification now.

priya (acct-mgr): customer asks if we can extend to 1h if things stay stable.

maya (sre): let's wait 15m. If we remain stable, I'll extend TTL to 60m and then schedule a controlled ramp down plan (10% decrements).

alex (oncall): set a watch: if error rate >4% or tail latency >2s we auto-escalate.

sam (runtime): logging mitigation: change_id rchg-20260317-01, feature toggle ft-20260317-01. Will attach traces.

alex (oncall): handoff note: I'll remain primary until 3337777800, then handoff to night-sre. Posting summary to incidents channel and creating a follow-up ticket.

maya (sre): assigning postmortem to sam and jordan. Target: initial writeup by EOD.

priya (acct-mgr): customer grateful, asked to be notified before rollback. :thumbsup:

alex (oncall): mitigation applied and holding. Will update after 15m check-in.

incident-bot: Reminder scheduled at +15m for follow-up (check: metrics, extend TTL if stable).
